questions.q: In its bi-monthly monetary policy of 3-5 August 2026, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee kept the policy repo rate unchanged. What are the policy repo rate and the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate after this policy?
questions.explanation: On 5 Aug 2026 the MPC voted unanimously to hold repo at 5.25% with a neutral stance, its fourth straight pause. The corridor is SDF 5.00% and MSF/Bank Rate 5.50% (Business Standard / CNBC TV18, 5 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In the August 2026 monetary policy, how did the RBI revise its projections of real GDP growth and CPI inflation for FY 2026-27?
options: GDP raised to 6.7%; CPI inflation lowered to 5.0%
GDP retained at 6.6%; CPI inflation retained at 5.1%
GDP lowered to 6.5%; CPI inflation raised to 5.2%
GDP raised to 7.0%; CPI inflation lowered to 4.1%
questions.explanation: The 5 Aug 2026 policy raised the FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7% and cut the FY27 CPI inflation forecast to 5.0% (New Indian Express / Moneycontrol / IIFL, 5 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Under the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2026, which came into effect on 1 July 2026, what is the maximum compensation the RBI Ombudsman can award for consequential loss, and for mental agony, harassment and expenses?
questions.explanation: RB-IOS 2026 took effect on 1 Jul 2026 and replaced RB-IOS 2021, which allowed Rs 20 lakh + Rs 1 lakh. It allows up to Rs 30 lakh for consequential loss plus Rs 3 lakh for non-financial loss, Rs 33 lakh in total (Business Standard 1 Jul 2026 / Economic Times 14 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI's final framework for compensating victims of small-value digital frauds (net loss up to Rs 50,000), notified in June 2026 and effective from 1 January 2027, how much compensation does an eligible customer receive?
options: 100% of the net loss, up to Rs 50,000
85% of the net loss or Rs 25,000, whichever is lower
75% of the net loss or Rs 30,000, whichever is lower
50% of the net loss, up to Rs 25,000
questions.explanation: The RBI's final framework (24 Jun 2026) pays 85% of the net loss, capped at Rs 25,000, as a once-in-a-lifetime benefit, effective 1 Jan 2027 (Indian Express / Livemint, 24-25 Jun 2026).

questions.q: NPCI has announced a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on person-to-merchant (P2M) UPI transactions with effect from 15 October 2026. What is the MDR, and on transactions above what value does it apply?
questions.explanation: NPCI set a 0.4% MDR on P2M UPI payments above Rs 2,000 from 15 Oct 2026, capped at Rs 300 (reached at Rs 75,000). The Supreme Court refused to stay it on 28 Sep 2026 (Entrackr 15 Sep / Indian Express 28 Sep 2026).

questions.q: In August 2026, NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) signed an agreement with National Interbank Processing Centre (NIPC), operator of the HUMO payment system, so that Indian travellers can pay with UPI by scanning the national QR code 'UZQR'. NIPC belongs to which country?
questions.explanation: NIPL partnered with Uzbekistan's NIPC (the HUMO operator) to accept UPI through UZQR. The deal was announced on 31 Aug 2026 and no rollout date has been set yet (Economic Times 31 Aug / MediaNama 1 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The RBI released the list of Upper Layer NBFCs (NBFC-UL) for 2026-27 on 6 August 2026. Which of the following is NOT one of the new entrants to the list?
questions.explanation: The FY27 NBFC-UL list grew to 17 entities. REC, PFC, IRFC and HUDCO were added, while Tata Sons stayed on from before (The Statesman 6 Aug / Adda247 7 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In September 2026, the Reserve Bank of India approved Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) to acquire an aggregate holding of up to 9.99% of the paid-up share capital or voting rights of which bank?
questions.explanation: The RBI approved LIC to acquire up to 9.99% of ICICI Bank, with one year to complete the acquisition (Business Standard / BusinessLine / Moneycontrol, 5 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026, which comes into force on 1 October 2026, replaces the Bankers' Books Evidence Act of which year?
questions.explanation: The new Act takes effect on 1 Oct 2026 and replaces the 1891 law. It gives legal recognition to digital banking records (DD News / Business Standard 11 Sep 2026; Organiser 14 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Under the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions, 2026, issued on 31 July 2026, within what time must a bank report a cyber security incident to the RBI on the DAKSH platform?
questions.explanation: The 31 Jul 2026 Directions require cyber incidents to be reported on DAKSH within six hours. Critical customer-facing systems need a vulnerability assessment every 6 months and a penetration test every 12 months (MediaNama, 3 Aug 2026).

questions.q: According to the RBI's Financial Stability Report (June 2026), what was the Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA) ratio of scheduled commercial banks in March 2026, a multi-decadal low?
questions.explanation: FSR June 2026: SCB GNPA fell to a multi-decadal low of 1.8% in Mar 2026, and stress tests show it could edge up to 1.9% by FY28 (Economic Times / Business Today, 30 Jun 2026).

questions.q: In May 2026, the RBI's Central Board approved a record surplus transfer to the Central Government for the accounting year 2025-26. What was the amount, approximately?
questions.explanation: On 22 May 2026 the RBI's Central Board approved a record Rs 2.87 lakh crore surplus transfer for FY26. FY25 was Rs 2.69 lakh crore and FY24 was Rs 2.11 lakh crore (Moneycontrol / DD News / ANI, 22 May 2026).

questions.q: Rohit Jain was appointed Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India for three years with effect from 3 May 2026. Whom did he succeed?
questions.explanation: The government appointed Rohit Jain as RBI Deputy Governor for 3 years from 3 May 2026 after T. Rabi Sankar's term ended (Business Standard / Economic Times, 2 May 2026).

questions.q: In July 2026, the Government of India approved an RBI proposal to put polymer (plastic) banknotes into field trials. Which denominations are included, with 1 billion notes of each?
questions.explanation: The government approved field trials of 1 billion each of Rs 10 and Rs 20 polymer notes (2 billion in total, about Rs 3,000 crore) and said there is no plan to replace paper notes (Indian Express / Economic Times, 27 Jul 2026).

questions.q: As per data released by the RBI in July 2026, what was the value of the composite Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) for March 2026?
questions.explanation: The FI-Index rose 4.48% to 70.0 in Mar 2026 from 67.0 in Mar 2025, led by the Usage sub-index. Its weights are Access 35%, Usage 45% and Quality 20% (ANI / Business Standard / Economic Times, 16 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI's draft guidelines of August 2026 to restart 'on-tap' licensing of Urban Co-operative Banks (UCBs), what minimum deposit base must a credit co-operative society have to apply for conversion into a UCB?
questions.explanation: The 5 Aug 2026 draft requires deposits of at least Rs 10,000 crore and net worth of at least Rs 300 crore. It resumes UCB licensing after 22 years, and only three co-ops currently qualify (ET BFSI / Business Standard, 5 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The RBI cancelled the banking licence of Paytm Payments Bank Ltd with effect from 24 April 2026, and the Delhi High Court later ordered the bank to be wound up. Under which Act did the RBI cancel the licence?
questions.explanation: The RBI cancelled PPBL's licence on 24 Apr 2026 under Section 22(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. In July 2026 the Delhi HC ordered winding up and appointed Girikumar M. Nair as Official Liquidator (The Hindu 24 Apr / Business Standard, Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI (Lending Against Gold and Silver Collateral) Directions, which took effect on 1 April 2026, what is the maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio for a gold loan of up to Rs 2.5 lakh?
questions.explanation: The gold and silver collateral norms, effective 1 Apr 2026, set LTV at 85% for loans up to Rs 2.5 lakh, 80% for Rs 2.5-5 lakh and 75% above Rs 5 lakh (Indian Express 7 Jun 2025 / Upstox Apr 2026).

questions.q: The RBI has approved the appointment of Mahesh Muralidhar Pai, a Canara Bank veteran, as MD & CEO of which private sector bank for three years from 1 October 2026?
questions.explanation: The RBI approved Mahesh Muralidhar Pai as MD & CEO of South Indian Bank for 3 years from 1 Oct 2026 (BusinessLine / Economic Times, 8 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Which of the following statements about banking in India is INCORRECT?
options: The Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) limit is USD 2,50,000 per financial year per resident individual
The Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number of an RTGS transaction has 22 characters
The minimum maturity period of a Certificate of Deposit (CD) is 7 days
From 1 April 2026, DICGC charges all insured banks a flat premium of 12 paise per Rs 100 of assessable deposits
questions.explanation: From 1 Apr 2026, DICGC charges a risk-based premium, from 8 paise per Rs 100 for the safest banks up to 12 paise, in place of the old flat 12 paise. The LRS, UTR and CD statements are correct (Economic Times / BusinessLine, 6-7 Feb 2026).

questions.q: According to the NSO data released on 31 August 2026, India's real GDP grew by how much in Q1 (April-June) of FY 2026-27?
questions.explanation: NSO/MoSPI, 31 Aug 2026 (The Hindu/Livemint/CNBC TV18): real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27, beating estimates. GVA grew 8.2%.

questions.q: India's CPI (retail) inflation for August 2026, released by MoSPI on 14 September 2026, was 4.82%. What is the base year of the new CPI series behind this figure?
questions.explanation: MoSPI/PIB press release, 14 Sep 2026: August 2026 CPI inflation was 4.82% (up from 4.45% in July) and food inflation 5.95%, on the new series with base 2024=100, which replaced the old 2012-base series.

questions.q: As per the Union Budget 2026-27 presented on 1 February 2026, what is the fiscal deficit target for FY 2026-27 as a share of GDP?
questions.explanation: Union Budget, 1 Feb 2026: the fiscal deficit target for FY27 is 4.3% of GDP (FY26 RE: 4.4%). Capex is Rs 12.2 lakh crore, and debt-to-GDP is to reach 50 +/- 1% by 2030-31.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a criterion for horizontal devolution of central taxes among states under the 16th Finance Commission (Chairman: Arvind Panagariya) for 2026-31?
questions.explanation: PRS summary of the 16th FC report, tabled 1 Feb 2026: states' share stays at 41%. 'Tax and fiscal effort' (2.5% under the 15th FC) was dropped, and the new 'contribution to GDP' criterion gets 10%. Income distance is 42.5%, population 17.5%, and demographic performance, area and forest are 10% each.

questions.q:
Consider these statements about the PM Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY), approved by the Union Cabinet on 31 July 2026:
I. Its total outlay is Rs 5,070 crore.
II. SECI is the implementing agency, under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
III. It targets 5,000 MW of floating solar PV with co-located storage of at least 2 hours.
Which of these statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Cabinet, 31 Jul 2026 (Insights IAS/StudyIQ/PIB): PM-SSY has an outlay of Rs 5,070 crore for 5,000 MW of floating solar with storage of at least 2 hours (10,000 MWh). CFA is Rs 1 crore per MW, MNRE is the nodal ministry and SECI implements the scheme.

questions.q: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of PM-KISAN from 2026-27 to 2030-31. What total financial outlay was approved for this period?
questions.explanation: Cabinet decision, 31 Jul 2026 (PMIndia/DD News): PM-KISAN continues to 2030-31 with an outlay of Rs 3.15 lakh crore. The benefit is Rs 6,000 a year, paid in 3 equal DBT instalments.

questions.q: On 16 September 2026, the Union Cabinet raised the wage ceiling for mandatory EPFO coverage from Rs 15,000 a month to how much?
questions.explanation: Cabinet, 16 Sep 2026 (The Hindu/Reuters/PIB): the ceiling rose to Rs 25,000 a month, bringing about 51 lakh more workers into coverage. It is the first hike in 12 years (Rs 15,000 since 2014). Rs 21,000 is the ESIC limit.

questions.q: The India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) came into force on 15 July 2026. Which other India-UK agreement took effect on the same day?
questions.explanation: DD India/PIB, Jul 2026: CETA and the Double Contribution Convention (the social security pact) both took effect on 15 Jul 2026. CETA gives duty-free access to about 99% of India's exports to the UK.

questions.q: Under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2026, approved at the SEBI board meeting on 24 September 2026, up to what share of client AUM can discretionary portfolio managers invest in unlisted investment-grade debt securities?
questions.explanation: SEBI board press release PR 59/2026, 24 Sep 2026: under DPMS, managers may invest up to 10% of client AUM in investment-grade, non-convertible unlisted debt, with client consent. The rules also allow IPO and foreign-security investments and create a Rs 25 lakh PRIM route for mutual funds.

questions.q: In June 2026, Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd (CPCL) was upgraded from Miniratna Category-I to Navratna status. Which number Navratna CPSE did it become?
questions.explanation: Govt order, 19 Jun 2026 (Economic Times/CNBC TV18): CPCL became India's 28th Navratna CPSE. A Navratna can invest up to Rs 1,000 crore or 15% of its net worth in one project without government approval.

questions.q: What was the theme of the 18th BRICS Summit held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026?
options: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
Strengthening Global South Cooperation for a More Inclusive and Sustainable Governance
Strengthening Multilateralism for Just Global Development and Security
BRICS and Africa: Partnership for Mutually Accelerated Growth, Sustainable Development and Inclusive Multilateralism
questions.explanation: PMIndia/DD News, Sep 2026: India hosted the 18th summit at Bharat Mandapam on 12-13 Sep 2026, its 4th chairship after 2012, 2016 and 2021, and the summit adopted the New Delhi Declaration. The other options are the themes of Brazil 2025, Russia 2024 and South Africa 2023.

questions.q: Sarnath (Uttar Pradesh) became India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site in July 2026. Where was the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee, at which it was inscribed, held?
questions.explanation: UNESCO/NDTV, 25 Jul 2026: Sarnath was inscribed at the 48th WHC session in Busan, the first held in Korea, after 28 years on the tentative list. The 46th session was held in New Delhi (2024) and the 47th in Paris (2025).

questions.q: At the 72nd National Film Awards, presented on 22 September 2026 at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, who received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award?
questions.explanation: PIB/The Hindu, 22 Sep 2026: President Murmu presented the 72nd National Film Awards at Ekta Nagar, Kevadia. Anant Nag received the Phalke Award, and Article 370 won Best Feature Film. Mohanlal received the previous Phalke Award, at the 71st awards.

questions.q: In the UN SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026, India recorded its best-ever rank in the SDG Index. What is that rank?
questions.explanation: SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026 (Down To Earth/Manorama, Jun 2026): India rose to 94th, its highest ever, from 99th in 2025, when it first entered the top 100.

questions.q: What is India's rank in the World Economic Forum's Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI) 2026?
questions.explanation: WEF TTDI 2026 (Business Today, 26 Sep 2026): India rose 9 places, from 39th in 2024, to 31st of 110 economies with a score of 4.42. Japan took 1st place from the US.

questions.q: Who is India's richest person according to the M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026?
questions.explanation: M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026, released 23 Sep 2026: Gautam Adani & family overtook Mukesh Ambani with about Rs 9.23 lakh crore. Ambani is 2nd.

questions.q: Where did India finish in the medal table at the 2026 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow?
questions.explanation: Glasgow CWG 2026 (Aug 2026): India finished 4th with 39 medals (13 gold, 17 silver, 9 bronze), including a record 7 boxing golds, even though wrestling and shooting were left out. Australia topped the table.

questions.q: Who were India's flag-bearers at the opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan?
options: Manu Bhaker and Tajinderpal Singh Toor
questions.explanation: Sportstar/India Today, 19 Sep 2026: shooter Manu Bhaker and kabaddi captain Pawan Sehrawat led India. Sehrawat replaced Tajinderpal Singh Toor, who was named first. Harmanpreet and Lovlina carried the flag at Hangzhou 2022.

questions.q: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup (hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico) by beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final?
questions.explanation: CNBC/Indian Express, 19-20 Jul 2026: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey, with an extra-time goal by Ferran Torres. It is Spain's 2nd title, after 2010.

questions.q: Economist Neelkanth Mishra was appointed India's Executive Director at the World Bank in June 2026. Besides India, which countries are in the constituency he represents?
questions.explanation: ACC approval, 4-5 Jun 2026 (ThePrint/BW People): Neelkanth Mishra was appointed for 3 years, succeeding Parameswaran Iyer. India's World Bank office (EDS12) represents India, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Sri Lanka.
